name: OSS_CONTACTS
description: Contacts table stores the subscription contact information.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: CONTACT_PUID
columns.description: PUID of the Contact

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Id from Parteis

columns.name: CONTACT_ROLE
columns.description: Role Of Contact

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Id of Subscription Header.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Relationship with party (contact_OF) for ecternal or resource id for internal

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Contact start date

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Contact end date

columns.name: OWNER_YN
columns.description: The identifier that indicates if the contact is the subscription owner or not

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL
columns.description: The contact's team security access level on the subscription

columns.name: BILLING_OWNER_YN
columns.description: The identifier that indicates if the contact is the billing owner of the subscription or not

columns.name: INTERNAL_YN
columns.description: This contact is Internal Contact or Not

columns.name: SIGNER_YN
columns.description: The identifier that indicates if the subscription contact is a signer or not, for electronic signature purposes

columns.name: SIGNER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The sequence in which the signer's signature has to appear in the subscription document, when the subscription is sent for electronic signature

columns.name: SIGNATURE_ROLE
columns.description: The signature role of the subscription contact for electronic signature purposes. For example, signature role can be signer, auto signer, information only.

columns.name: ROUTING_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The routing sequence of the subscription contact for electronic signature purposes.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
